findings.title: Deleting cache leaves the displayed status stale
findings.body: The delete mutation calls `onSuccess`, but unlike the disconnect mutation it never invalidates `viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars`. When this component is used without an `onSuccess` callback (or the callback does not refetch this query), the cached query result still contains the old `cacheUpdatedAt`, so the dropdown continues to show a cache status and delete action after the cache rows have been removed. Invalidate the connected-calendars query on success or settlement so the UI reflects the deletion.
